seo.title: Online B2B Marketplace Development [2023] | KeyDevs Technologies
seo.description: How to build an online B2B marketplace: business models, must-have features, technology choices, a launch plan and how to solve the chicken-and-egg problem.

body.text: B2B transactions made a major shift from on-site deals to online platforms during the COVID-19 pandemic, and the change has stayed. Buyers now expect to find suppliers, compare prices and place orders online. That has created a big opportunity for marketplace founders.

A B2B marketplace is a platform where businesses buy from and sell to other businesses. Unlike consumer marketplaces, orders are larger, prices are often negotiated and buyers expect invoicing, credit terms and account management.

items: Subscription fees for suppliers or buyers.
Value-added services such as logistics or financing.
Product catalogue with advanced search and filters.
Ratings, reviews and an admin dashboard.

body.text: Pick a scalable stack that your team can maintain. A modular architecture lets you start with the core flows and add integrations, such as ERP, shipping and payment gateways, as you grow.
Start with one niche and one side of the market. Recruit a small group of quality suppliers first, give them tools that are useful on their own, and then invite buyers.
A good marketplace removes friction for both sides. Begin with a focused MVP, measure how the platform is used and expand step by step.
